title: Question definition
description: The shape of a question, not the content of any question bank. Lets anyone author a bank - in any jurisdiction - that a validator of this schema accepts. No question without a stated reason: every question names who asks for it and explains why. Never reproduce a third-party form's field set.

questionId.description: module.question_name - the module in kebab-case, the question in snake_case. A permanent identifier once published.

module.description: The module this question belongs to. Must match the prefix of questionId.

jurisdiction.description: Where this question applies. Always an array, even where every value in a bank is the same: other implementers will author banks with other values, and a product's build scope must not become a property of the shared schema.

appliesWhen.description: Ask this question only when the field at fieldPath equals the given value. Absent means always applicable.

prompt.description: The question as the owner sees it.

helpText.description: Why this is asked, in plain language. Required: it is what turns an interrogation into an explanation.

whoAsks.description: Who will ask the owner for this - for example buyer-conveyancer, lender. At least one.

mapsToComponents.description: The components in the register this question contributes to. At least one.

options.description: The permitted answers. Required for enum and multi-enum questions, and not permitted otherwise. Include a not-sure option: unknown is a legitimate answer, not an unfinished one.

allowsEvidence.description: Whether the owner may attach a document to their answer.

evidenceTypes.description: The kinds of document accepted as evidence - for example pdf, image. Required when allowsEvidence is true.

weight.description: The question's weight in its module's completeness. Published as a guess, and to be read as one.

answerType.title: AnswerType
answerType.description: A closed vocabulary: adding a token is a MAJOR change.
